reuse.why: The new linkBankSyncAccount helper is used by all six providers, but releaseExistingLink re-writes unlinkAccount's field reset and the Fintegra download/balance code copies the Akahu versions instead of sharing them.

duplication.why: downloadFintegraTransactions is a line-for-line copy of downloadAkahuTransactions, the fintegra starting-balance branch copies the akahu one, the unlink reset is copied, and the same assertBankAccountNotLinked call is repeated in six provider functions.

placement.why: Linking logic sits in accounts/app.ts as before, but the link-rule check lives outside the shared linking function and is invoked separately by each provider wrapper, while release lives inside it.

scope.why: Changes stay on linking, Fintegra and its tests/release notes; the small client edits are needed for the extended provider union.

maintainability.why: The step-0 consolidation is good, but the guard split from the helper (six call sites must remember to call it) and the copied provider code mean future rule or provider changes touch several places.

bypasses_abstraction.where: releaseExistingLink in accounts/app.ts re-implements the account reset of unlinkAccount instead of sharing it; assertBankAccountNotLinked is called from each provider rather than inside linkBankSyncAccount.

disguised_duplication.where: The duplicated blocks (Fintegra download and balance branch, unlink field reset) are plain copies, not reshaped.

abstraction_drift.where: linkBankSyncAccount gained replaceExistingLink; the not-linked/closed guard was not put in the helper, so all six provider wrappers (goCardless, simpleFin, pluggyai, akahu, fintegra, enableBanking) each call assertBankAccountNotLinked before it.
